name: Activation - Gas-Phase Reduction (H2)
description: Reduces the calcined oxide to the metal in flowing hydrogen, then passivates it for shipment. Add this route after a powder or shaped route when the product is sold pre-reduced.

step_quantities.note: Reduction; the hydrogen furnace is costed at the indirect kiln rate

source: Munnik, de Jongh and de Jong, Recent developments in the synthesis of supported catalysts, Chem. Rev. 115, 6687 (2015)
route_note: Costed as one kiln pass plus flaring. Hydrogen consumption enters as a material.
uncosted_operations: Hydrogen reduction furnace: costed at the indirect kiln rate
